text: Hino e naafiqi'en, lorrirayɓe Nulaaɗo Alla on (yo o his) konngol, tuma ɓe seeditii yaafuyee makko on, ɓe wi'a : "O heɗitoto kala haala, o senndindirtaa hakkunde goonga e fenaande". -Maakan ɓe an Nulaaɗo : Nulaaɗo Alla on heɗotaako si wanaa moƴƴere,himo goongini Alla, o goongini kumpite gomɗimɓe goonga ɓen, himo yurmee ɓe kadi. Pellet, Nulal makko ngal ko yurmeende wonannde ɓen gomɗimɓe mo. Ɓen non lorrayɓe Nulaaɗo Alla on kala noone, hino woodani ɓen lepte muusuɗe.
